description: This file contains the implementation of an Android activity demonstrating the use of the Trigger Sensor API, specifically the Significant Motion sensor. It includes a custom TriggerEventListener class (TriggerListener) and the main Activity class (TriggerSensors) that manages sensor registration, callback handling, and UI updates.

classes.name: TriggerListener
classes.description: Custom TriggerEventListener that updates a TextView when Significant Motion is detected.

classes.name: TriggerSensors
classes.description: Main Activity demonstrating registration and handling of trigger sensors, specifically for significant motion detection.

methods.name: onTrigger
methods.description: Callback invoked when the trigger sensor detects an event, updates the UI with detection messages.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers the trigger sensor when the activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Cancels the trigger sensor registration during activity pause to conserve resources.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and prepares the trigger sensor and UI components.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Ensures trigger sensor is cancelled when activity stops.
